item.title: Should you normalize RGB values by 255 or 256?
item.description:
📝 This means that when converting floating-point values in the [0, 1] range back to integers, the extreme bins have effectively half the width of other bins. Assume your processing subtracts 0. The second issue is that the standard approach’s floating-point values aren’t exact.
